**Subject:** Following up on dental filling at Bright Smile Dental

Michael,

Quick update on the cavity filling Dr. James Park found during my cleaning at Bright Smile Dental last October (Oct 22). The appointment notes say a filling was "scheduled" for the lower left molar, but I don't have the date in my calendar. 

Could you help me follow up with Bright Smile Dental to confirm when that filling appointment is? I may have forgotten to add it, or we need to schedule it if it wasn't booked yet.

Thanks!
Alice
